dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetric 2D geometric narrowing from the maximum lateral width at the mid-body toward a narrow point at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with no significant asymmetrical bulges or indentations visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median intensity visible across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency darker grey shading along the posterior-lateral quadrants.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the lighter central dorsal axis and slightly darker lateral margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible circular dark aperture (blowhole) on the anterior dorsal surface.
